c.h: Paul Greets the Saints in Rome

c: I might have a prosperous journey
that I may be comforted together
by the things that are made
the things that are more excellent

c.h: Death in Adam, Life in Christ

c: of him that was to come

c.h: Dead to Sin, Alive to God

c: shall lay any thing to the charge
of them that preach the gospel
the olive tree which is wild

c.h: Christ the Servant of Jews and Gentiles
Paul the Minister to the Gentiles

c: to be brought on my way
to him that is of power
